title: Consider providing additional ways to convert text into tokens

statement.en: Consider additional shortcuts for converting text into tokens.
statement.ja: textをtokenへ変換する追加shortcutを検討する。

conditions: Comma entry already performs the default conversion.
Return is an example additional shortcut, not a required key binding.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Token fields experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるToken fieldsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Consider customizing the delay the system uses before showing suggested tokens

statement.en: Consider a comfortable delay before showing suggested tokens.
statement.ja: suggested token表示前のcomfortableなdelayを検討する。

conditions: The app suggests tokens while people type.
Adjust the default immediate presentation if it distracts from typing.
